message: Based on the documents, what are the key features of RAG?

chat_history.message: What is RAG in the context of LLMs?
RAG stands for Retrieval Augmented Generation. It's a technique that enhances LLM responses by grounding them in external knowledge sources.

documents.title: RAG Overview
documents.snippet: Retrieval Augmented Generation combines the power of large language models with external knowledge retrieval systems.

documents.title: RAG Benefits
documents.snippet: RAG reduces hallucinations by grounding responses in verified documents and enables inline citations.
